channel.title: Features on Soulsolid
channel.description: Recent content in Features on Soulsolid

item.title: Library
item.description: The Library is the heart of Soulsolid: it’s your music collection once it has been imported. Everything else in the app (importing, downloading, tagging, lyrics) ends up here, and the Library section is where you browse, search, inspect and clean it up.

item.title: Downloading
item.description: The Download section lets you search external music services and download tracks, albums, whole artists and playlists. Soulsolid doesn’t come with any music service built in: each service is added through a downloader plugin, so what you can search and download depends on the plugins you have configured. See Downloading for how to install one.

item.title: Importing
item.description: Importing is how music gets into your library. Point Soulsolid at a folder and it reads each file’s tags, checks whether you already have the song, organizes the file into your library folder and adds it to the library. Anything that needs your decision, such as a duplicate or a track with missing tags, is held in a review queue instead of being imported blindly.

item.title: Metadata / Tagging
item.description: The tag editor is where you view and fix a track’s tags. You can edit them by hand, or pull metadata from online providers (MusicBrainz, Discogs and Deezer) and review it before saving. Soulsolid can also identify tracks by how they sound using AcoustID, either one track at a time or for your whole library.

item.title: Lyrics
item.description: Soulsolid can find lyrics for your tracks and save them into the audio files, so any player that reads embedded lyrics can show them. You can fetch lyrics for one track from the tag editor, or run a lyrics analysis over your whole library. Because lyrics you’ve curated by hand are easy to lose, Soulsolid never overwrites existing lyrics without asking: anything unclear goes to a review queue.

item.title: Reorganize
item.description: Reorganize moves the files already in your library so they match your current path templates. When you change how folders and files are named, or fix the tags of a bunch of tracks, the files on disk are still in their old place. Reorganize works out where each track should be and moves it there.

item.title: Merge
item.description: Over time a library collects the same artist, album or genre spelled in slightly different ways: Hip-Hop, Hip Hop and hiphop, or Un Verano Sin Tí and un verano sin ti. It also collects the same song stored twice, say a FLAC and an MP3 of the same recording. The Merge section finds these and lets you clean them up.

item.title: Playlists
item.description: Playlists let you group tracks from your library into named, ordered lists and export them as standard .m3u files that other players and devices can open.

item.title: Streaming
item.description: Soulsolid has a built-in audio player so you can listen to a track right in the browser while you browse, tag or review your music. It’s there to help you check what you’re looking at (is this the right version? is the file broken?) rather than to be a full music player.

item.title: Metrics
item.description: Metrics turn your library into charts on the dashboard, so you can see what your collection is made of and how well tagged it is.
